title: The Signature College Directory Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Institution names, official websites, locations, and institutional identifiers. The College Directory Database lists institutions with their official names, websites, locations, and identifiers such as IPEDS codes where published. Records distinguish main campuses from branches and note institutional type and accreditation status from public sources. The Signature side adds comparison views that line up institutions side by side on the factors students actually compare.
capabilities: List institutions with official names, websites, and locations
Record institutional identifiers and published accreditation status
Distinguish main campuses from branch and satellite locations
Compare institutions side by side on key factors
Link each institution to its service databases in this network
